title: SBAR handoff and read-back
description: A structured handoff or call: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation, and the receiver's read-back. An element that is deliberately missing is shown as 'Not stated'. Synthetic patient.

marking.description: Exercise marking printed above the form
examples: EXERCISE · SIMULATED PATIENT · NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

from.description: Who is giving the report (role and name)

situation.description: Situation: the patient, the problem now
examples: Mr. Delgado in 4 West bed 12 has become hypotensive and confused in the last hour.

background.description: Background: reason for admission, history, medications, allergies, recent results. Empty if not stated
examples: Admitted two days ago after bowel surgery; on piperacillin-tazobactam; creatinine 1.9, lactate 4.8.

assessment.description: Assessment: the nurse's reading of severity. Empty if not stated
examples: BP 82/50, HR 124, RR 26, SpO2 91 percent on 2 L, temperature 38.9 C. I think he is septic and getting worse.

recommendation.description: Recommendation or request. Empty if not stated
examples: Please come to the bedside within 15 minutes; I am calling rapid response now and request fluids and cultures.

readBack.description: The receiver's read-back, or empty if none
examples: Hypotensive, confused, lactate 4.8; I will come now and order a fluid bolus and cultures.
